question_record.context: A Suspicious sequence of exploration activities was identified on July 4, 2024, indicating potential asset identification and lateral movement by an attacker. Several processes were executed including `whoami.exe` and `powershell.exe`. The commands were executed by the user with SID `S-1-5-21-561436748-3867387497-1732241745-3701` from the host `mb-winclient`, which has the AadDeviceId `7661dfd4-218f-4016-8a87-66d68a7f098e`.
question_record.question: Who performed the unusual addition of credentials to the OAuth app SimulandApp?
solution: Suspicious sequence of exploration activities was detected, initiated by a user with AadUserId `2de70991-2799-4a95-b734-8e3df3a50118`.
Luciano Herrera (pwilson@niseko.alpineskihouse.co) performed an unusual addition of credentials, specifically a password, to the application SimulandApp.

57.name: Suspicious sequence of exploration activities
57.description: A process called a set of windows commands. These commands can be used by attackers in order to identify assets of value and coordinate lateral movement after compromising a machine.

80.name: Unusual addition of credentials to an OAuth app
80.description: The user Luciano Herrera (pwilson@niseko.alpineskihouse.co) performed an unusual addition of credentials to the application SimulandApp. This usage pattern may indicate that an attacker has compromised the app, and is using it to spread phishing, exfiltrate data, or to gain access to other accounts and devices. The user added a credential of type Password. A credential of type Password is added when an application is using a password to authenticate.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_Name' AND o.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID'
